name: Grand Hyatt Cayman Resort
positioning: Grand Hyatt Grand Cayman Resort & Spa, an oceanfront resort with a spa and suites on the southern tip of Seven Mile Beach
best_for: Families who want a kids' camp and connecting rooms
Groups wanting multi-bedroom oceanfront suites with kitchens
Travelers who want water sports and snorkeling from the resort

facts.text: The resort is on the southern tip of Seven Mile Beach.
The resort is 10 minutes from Owen Roberts International Airport.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and natural decor.
Some oceanfront suites have a full kitchen and a dining table seating six.
Grand Club guests get daily breakfast in an indoor lounge with an oceanfront terrace and an evening cocktail hour.
Camp Hyatt offers marine-themed activities for children ages 4 to 12.
Resort activities include nonmotorized water sports such as kayaks and stand-up paddleboards, plus snorkeling gear.
The resort offers local cultural experiences such as marine life sessions for children and thatch art.
The fitness center has cardio and weight training equipment and space for yoga.
Salt + Cinder is a globally inspired restaurant built around cooking with water and fire.
Hi Tide is a terrace cevicheria perched above Lo Tide, designed for watching Cayman sunsets.

highlights.text: The resort has oceanfront pools, including a family pool, the spa's vitality pool and a main pool with a swim-up bar.
Mera Spa has 14 indoor and outdoor treatment rooms.
The 3 Bedroom Silver Thatch Residence is an oceanfront suite with a kitchen and an oversize furnished terrace.
Many rooms and suites have balconies and ocean views and can connect to adjoining rooms.

considerations.text: Dogs and cats under 70 pounds are welcome, up to two per reservation, at no charge.
Valet parking is free for guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
